tileParams.description: Where machines go: a valley of dead Flivvers, spent boilers, one half-buried thing nobody names. Salvage economy: strip parts under pressure while pipeline rustlers strip the SAME yard, a race in slow motion over bones. Nothing in the boneyard attacks unless woken, and the map rewards leaving the sleeper asleep; no tooltip ever says so. Engine dependency: the salvage-race consumer (strip-under-pressure economy, rival rustler crews, sleeper wake trigger) does not exist yet.

objectives.description: Strip more of the yard than the pipeline rustlers do.
Hold the Gate Camp through wave 12.

teachingIntent.description: Teaches the economy of the dead and respect for old machines; the yard rewards those who leave the sleeper asleep, and no tooltip ever says so.

engineDependencies.description: Needs a strip-under-pressure salvage economy, rival rustler crews working the same hulks, and the sleeper's wake trigger with its untold reward for leaving it asleep.

Ten harvest grounds lie among the old machines.
Waves enter from the west and east.
